fullText.simplified:
元树

    元树很有名，也有很多军队，但是他的地方不多，他要找厉害的人来为他工作，帮他得到更多地方。虽然孙策很年轻，但是元树知道他和他爸爸一样，都是特别厉害的人，元树太想孙策来为他工作了。
    元树给孙策写了三年的信，他等了孙策三年。现在孙策终于来了，他马上把最重要的工作给了孙策。他让孙策带着军队去打两个大城市，很快，孙策拿下了那两个城市。现在这两个城市是元树的了，元树非常高兴。
    孙策为元树工作了一年。这一年里，他一直在帮元树打仗。孙策打败的人越多，元树得到的地方就越多。元树很高兴，但是孙策一点儿都不高兴。离开的时间越长，孙策就越想回江东。
    一天，孙策的妈妈给孙策写信，在信里说，有个叫“刘要”的人，想做江东的主人，带着军队来打“曲阿”了。
    孙策知道刘要。刘要在江东有很多军队，还有很多厉害的助手，是个有名的人。妈妈和家人们住在曲阿，现在，他们又有危险了。
    孙策很着急，拿着信去见元树。
    元树正在吃饭。孙策站在饭桌旁边，对元树说：“刘要准备打曲阿，我妈妈和家人们都住在曲阿，他们有危险。爸爸死了，我不能杀了刘表，已经对不起爸爸了。如果现在还不能保护妈妈，我就更对不起爸爸了。请您帮帮我，借我一支军队，我去曲阿打刘要，保护妈妈。”
    元树吃了一口菜，慢慢地说：“策，刘要不会打曲阿，你妈妈很安全，你不要担心。”
    孙策着急地说：“刘要真的要打曲阿，请您相信我。”
    元树再慢慢喝了一口茶，说：“不，你要相信我，刘要不会打曲阿。”
    孙策不说话了，他明白了，不是元树不相信他，是元树不想放他走。
fullText.traditional:
元樹

    元樹很有名，也有很多軍隊，但是他的地方不多，他要找厲害的人來為他工作，幫他得到更多地方。雖然孫策很年輕，但是元樹知道他和他爸爸一樣，都是特別厲害的人，元樹太想孫策來為他工作了。
    元樹給孫策寫了三年的信，他等了孫策三年。現在孫策終於來了，他馬上把最重要的工作給了孫策。他讓孫策帶著軍隊去打兩個大城市，很快，孫策拿下了那兩個城市。現在這兩個城市是元樹的了，元樹非常高興。
    孫策為元樹工作了一年。這一年裡，他一直在幫元樹打仗。孫策打敗的人越多，元樹得到的地方就越多。元樹很高興，但是孫策一點兒都不高興。離開的時間越長，孫策就越想回江東。
    一天，孫策的媽媽給孫策寫信，在信裡說，有個叫“劉要”的人，想做江東的主人，帶著軍隊來打“曲阿”了。
    孫策知道劉要。劉要在江東有很多軍隊，還有很多厲害的助手，是個有名的人。媽媽和家人們住在曲阿，現在，他們又有危險了。
    孫策很著急，拿著信去見元樹。
    元樹正在吃飯。孫策站在飯桌旁邊，對元樹說：“劉要準備打曲阿，我媽媽和家人們都住在曲阿，他們有危險。爸爸死了，我不能殺了劉表，已經對不起爸爸了。如果現在還不能保護媽媽，我就更對不起爸爸了。請您幫幫我，借我一支軍隊，我去曲阿打劉要，保護媽媽。”
    元樹吃了一口菜，慢慢地說：“策，劉要不會打曲阿，你媽媽很安全，你不要擔心。”
    孫策著急地說：“劉要真的要打曲阿，請您相信我。”
    元樹再慢慢喝了一口茶，說：“不，你要相信我，劉要不會打曲阿。”
    孫策不說話了，他明白了，不是元樹不相信他，是元樹不想放他走。

sentences.simplified: 元树很有名，也有很多军队，但是他的地方不多，
sentences.traditional: 元樹很有名，也有很多軍隊，但是他的地方不多，
sentences.pinyin: yuán shù hěn yǒu míng yě yǒu hěn duō jūn duì dàn shì tā de dì fang bù duō
sentences.english: Yuan Shu was very famous, and he had many troops, but he did not have much territory.

sentences.simplified: 他要找厉害的人来为他工作，帮他得到更多地方。
sentences.traditional: 他要找厲害的人來為他工作，幫他得到更多地方。
sentences.pinyin: tā yào zhǎo lì hai de rén lái wèi tā gōng zuò bāng tā dé dào gèng duō dì fang
sentences.english: He wanted to find formidable people to work for him and help him obtain more territory.

sentences.simplified: 虽然孙策很年轻，但是元树知道他和他爸爸一样，都是特别厉害的人，
sentences.traditional: 雖然孫策很年輕，但是元樹知道他和他爸爸一樣，都是特別厲害的人，
sentences.pinyin: suī rán sūn cè hěn nián qīng dàn shì yuán shù zhī dào tā hé tā bà ba yí yàng dōu shì tè bié lì hai de rén
sentences.english: Although Sun Ce was very young, Yuan Shu knew that he, like his father, was very formidable.

sentences.simplified: 元树太想孙策来为他工作了。
sentences.traditional: 元樹太想孫策來為他工作了。
sentences.pinyin: yuán shù tài xiǎng sūn cè lái wèi tā gōng zuò le
sentences.english: Yuan Shu really wanted Sun Ce to come work for him.

sentences.simplified: 元树给孙策写了三年的信，他等了孙策三年。
sentences.traditional: 元樹給孫策寫了三年的信，他等了孫策三年。
sentences.pinyin: yuán shù gěi sūn cè xiě le sān nián de xìn tā děng le sūn cè sān nián
sentences.english: Yuan Shu wrote to Sun Ce for three years. He waited for Sun Ce for three years.

sentences.simplified: 现在孙策终于来了，他马上把最重要的工作给了孙策。
sentences.traditional: 現在孫策終於來了，他馬上把最重要的工作給了孫策。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài sūn cè zhōng yú lái le tā mǎ shàng bǎ zuì zhòng yào de gōng zuò gěi le sūn cè
sentences.english: Now, Sun Ce was finally here. He gave the most important task to Sun Ce right away.

sentences.simplified: 他让孙策带着军队去打两个大城市，很快，孙策拿下了那两个城市。
sentences.traditional: 他讓孫策帶著軍隊去打兩個大城市，很快，孫策拿下了那兩個城市。
sentences.pinyin: tā ràng sūn cè dài zhe jūn duì qù dǎ liǎng ge dà chéng shì hěn kuài sūn cè ná xià le nà liǎng ge chéng shì
sentences.english: He asked Sun Ce to take the troops and fight two large cities. Very soon, Sun Ce captured these two cities.

sentences.simplified: 现在这两个城市是元树的了，元树非常高兴。
sentences.traditional: 現在這兩個城市是元樹的了，元樹非常高興。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài zhè liǎng ge chéng shì shì yuán shù de le yuán shù fēi cháng gāo xìng
sentences.english: Now, these two cities belonged to Yuan Shu. Yuan Shu was very happy.

sentences.simplified: 孙策为元树工作了一年。这一年里，他一直在帮元树打仗。
sentences.traditional: 孫策為元樹工作了一年。這一年裡，他一直在幫元樹打仗。
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè wèi yuán shù gōng zuò le yì nián zhè yì nián lǐ tā yì zhí zài bāng yuán shù dǎ zhàng
sentences.english: Sun Ce worked for Yuan Shu for one year. In this year, he was constantly helping Yuan Shu fight battles.

sentences.simplified: 孙策打败的人越多，元树得到的地方就越多。
sentences.traditional: 孫策打敗的人越多，元樹得到的地方就越多。
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè dǎ bài de rén yuè duō yuán shù dé dào de dì fang jiù yuè duō
sentences.english: The more people Sun Ce defeated, the more territory Yuan Shu obtained.

sentences.simplified: 元树很高兴，但是孙策一点儿都不高兴。
sentences.traditional: 元樹很高興，但是孫策一點兒都不高興。
sentences.pinyin: yuán shù hěn gāo xìng dàn shì sūn cè yì diǎn'r dōu bù gāo xìng
sentences.english: Yuan Shu was very happy, but Sun Ce was not happy at all.

sentences.simplified: 离开的时间越长，孙策就越想回江东。
sentences.traditional: 離開的時間越長，孫策就越想回江東。
sentences.pinyin: lí kāi de shí jiān yuè cháng sūn cè jiù yuè xiǎng huí jiāng dōng
sentences.english: The longer he was away, the more Sun Ce wanted to return to Jiangdong.

sentences.simplified: 一天，孙策的妈妈给孙策写信，在信里说，有个叫“刘要”的人，
sentences.traditional: 一天，孫策的媽媽給孫策寫信，在信裡說，有個叫“劉要”的人，
sentences.pinyin: yì tiān sūn cè de mā ma gěi sūn cè xiě xìn zài xìn lǐ shuō yǒu ge jiào liú yào de rén
sentences.english: One day, Sun Ce’s mother wrote Sun Ce a letter. The letter said that there was a man named “Liu Yao”.

sentences.simplified: 想做江东的主人，带着军队来打“曲阿”了。
sentences.traditional: 想做江東的主人，帶著軍隊來打“曲阿”了。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎng zuò jiāng dōng de zhǔ rén dài zhe jūn duì lái dǎ qǔ ā le
sentences.english: Liu Yao wanted to be the master of Jiangdong and had brought his troops to attack Qu’a.

sentences.simplified: 孙策知道刘要。刘要在江东有很多军队，还有很多厉害的助手，是个有名的人。
sentences.traditional: 孫策知道劉要。劉要在江東有很多軍隊，還有很多厲害的助手，是個有名的人。
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè zhī dào liú yào liú yào zài jiāng dōng yǒu hěn duō jūn duì hái yǒu hěn duō lì hai de zhù shǒu shì ge yǒu míng de rén
sentences.english: Sun Ce knew of Liu Yao. Liu Yao had many troops in Jiangdong, and also had many formidable assistants. He was a famous person.

sentences.simplified: 妈妈和家人们住在曲阿，现在，他们又有危险了。
sentences.traditional: 媽媽和家人們住在曲阿，現在，他們又有危險了。
sentences.pinyin: mā ma hé jiā rén men zhù zài qǔ ā xiàn zài tā men yòu yǒu wēi xiǎn le
sentences.english: His mother and family members lived in Qu’a, and now, they were in danger again.

sentences.simplified: 孙策很着急，拿着信去见元树。
sentences.traditional: 孫策很著急，拿著信去見元樹。
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè hěn zháo jí ná zhe xìn qù jiàn yuán shù
sentences.english: Sun Ce was very worried. He went to see Yuan Shu with the letter.

sentences.simplified: 元树正在吃饭。
sentences.traditional: 元樹正在吃飯。
sentences.pinyin: yuán shù zhèng zài chī fàn
sentences.english: Yuan Shu was eating at that moment.

sentences.simplified: 孙策站在饭桌旁边，对元树说：
sentences.traditional: 孫策站在飯桌旁邊，對元樹說：
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè zhàn zài fàn zhuō páng biān duì yuán shù shuō
sentences.english: Sun Ce stood next to the dining table and said to Yuan Shu, ..

sentences.simplified: “刘要准备打曲阿，我妈妈和家人们都住在曲阿，他们有危险。
sentences.traditional: “劉要準備打曲阿，我媽媽和家人們都住在曲阿，他們有危險。
sentences.pinyin: liú yào zhǔn bèi dǎ qǔ ā wǒ mā ma hé jiā rén men dōu zhù zài qǔ ā tā men yǒu wēi xiǎn
sentences.english: .. “Liu Yao is about to attack Qu’a. My mother and family all live in Qu’a. They are in danger.

sentences.simplified: 爸爸死了，我不能杀了刘表，已经对不起爸爸了。
sentences.traditional: 爸爸死了，我不能殺了劉表，已經對不起爸爸了。
sentences.pinyin: bà ba sǐ le wǒ bù néng shā le liú biǎo yǐ jīng duì bu qǐ bà ba le
sentences.english: My father is dead, and I have already let him down with my inability to kill Liu Biao.

sentences.simplified: 如果现在还不能保护妈妈，我就更对不起爸爸了。
sentences.traditional: 如果現在還不能保護媽媽，我就更對不起爸爸了。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ xiàn zài hái bù néng bǎo hù mā ma wǒ jiù gèng duì bu qǐ bà ba le
sentences.english: If I can’t even protect my mother now, I will let my father down even more.

sentences.simplified: 请您帮帮我，借我一支军队，我去曲阿打刘要，保护妈妈。”
sentences.traditional: 請您幫幫我，借我一支軍隊，我去曲阿打劉要，保護媽媽。”
sentences.pinyin: qǐng nín bāng bāng wǒ jiè wǒ yì zhī jūn duì wǒ qù qǔ ā dǎ liú yào bǎo hù mā ma
sentences.english: Please help me and lend me an army. I will go to Qu’a to fight Liu Yao and protect my mother.”

sentences.simplified: 元树吃了一口菜，慢慢地说：“策，刘要不会打曲阿，你妈妈很安全，你不要担心。”
sentences.traditional: 元樹吃了一口菜，慢慢地說：“策，劉要不會打曲阿，你媽媽很安全，你不要擔心。”
sentences.pinyin: yuán shù chī le yì kǒu cài màn man de shuō cè liú yào bú huì dǎ qǔ ā nǐ mā ma hěn ān quán nǐ bú yào dān xīn
sentences.english: Yuan Shu ate a bite of food and said slowly, “Ce, Liu Yao won’t attack Qu’a. Your mother is very safe. Don’t worry.”

sentences.simplified: 孙策着急地说：“刘要真的要打曲阿，请您相信我。”
sentences.traditional: 孫策著急地說：“劉要真的要打曲阿，請您相信我。”
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè zháo jí de shuō liú yào zhēn de yào dǎ qǔ ā qǐng nín xiāng xìn wǒ
sentences.english: Sun Ce said anxiously, “Liu Yao is really going to attack Qu’a. Please believe me.”

sentences.simplified: 元树再慢慢喝了一口茶，说：“不，你要相信我，刘要不会打曲阿。”
sentences.traditional: 元樹再慢慢喝了一口茶，說：“不，你要相信我，劉要不會打曲阿。”
sentences.pinyin: yuán shù zài màn man hē le yì kǒu chá shuō bù nǐ yào xiāng xìn wǒ liú yào bú huì dǎ qǔ ā
sentences.english: Yuan Shu then slowly took a sip of tea and said, “No, you need to trust me. Liu Yao won’t attack Qu’a.”

sentences.simplified: 孙策不说话了，
sentences.traditional: 孫策不說話了，
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè bù shuō huà le
sentences.english: Sun Ce didn’t say anything further.

sentences.simplified: 他明白了，不是元树不相信他，是元树不想放他走。
sentences.traditional: 他明白了，不是元樹不相信他，是元樹不想放他走。
sentences.pinyin: tā míng bai le bú shì yuán shù bù xiāng xìn tā shì yuán shù bù xiǎng fàng tā zǒu
sentences.english: He understood that it wasn’t because Yuan Shu didn’t believe him; it was because Yuan Shu didn’t want to let him go.

sentence_translations: Yuan Shu
Yuan Shu was very famous, and he had many troops, but he did not have much territory.
He wanted to find formidable people to work for him and help him obtain more territory.
Although Sun Ce was very young, Yuan Shu knew that he, like his father, was very formidable.
Yuan Shu really wanted Sun Ce to come work for him.
Yuan Shu wrote to Sun Ce for three years. He waited for Sun Ce for three years.
Now, Sun Ce was finally here. He gave the most important task to Sun Ce right away.
He asked Sun Ce to take the troops and fight two large cities. Very soon, Sun Ce captured these two cities.
Now, these two cities belonged to Yuan Shu. Yuan Shu was very happy.
Sun Ce worked for Yuan Shu for one year. In this year, he was constantly helping Yuan Shu fight battles.
The more people Sun Ce defeated, the more territory Yuan Shu obtained.
Yuan Shu was very happy, but Sun Ce was not happy at all.
The longer he was away, the more Sun Ce wanted to return to Jiangdong.
One day, Sun Ce’s mother wrote Sun Ce a letter. The letter said that there was a man named “Liu Yao”.
Liu Yao wanted to be the master of Jiangdong and had brought his troops to attack Qu’a.
Sun Ce knew of Liu Yao. Liu Yao had many troops in Jiangdong, and also had many formidable assistants. He was a famous person.
His mother and family members lived in Qu’a, and now, they were in danger again.
Sun Ce was very worried. He went to see Yuan Shu with the letter.
Yuan Shu was eating at that moment.
Sun Ce stood next to the dining table and said to Yuan Shu, ..
.. “Liu Yao is about to attack Qu’a. My mother and family all live in Qu’a. They are in danger.
My father is dead, and I have already let him down with my inability to kill Liu Biao.
If I can’t even protect my mother now, I will let my father down even more.
Please help me and lend me an army. I will go to Qu’a to fight Liu Yao and protect my mother.”
Yuan Shu ate a bite of food and said slowly, “Ce, Liu Yao won’t attack Qu’a. Your mother is very safe. Don’t worry.”
Sun Ce said anxiously, “Liu Yao is really going to attack Qu’a. Please believe me.”
Yuan Shu then slowly took a sip of tea and said, “No, you need to trust me. Liu Yao won’t attack Qu’a.”
Sun Ce didn’t say anything further.
He understood that it wasn’t because Yuan Shu didn’t believe him; it was because Yuan Shu didn’t want to let him go.
